name: MPCI-Bench
description: MPCI-Bench (Multimodal Pairwise Contextual Integrity Benchmark) is a benchmark dataset for evaluating the contextual integrity awareness of language model agents in multimodal scenarios. The benchmark assesses whether VLM agents appropriately handle privacy-sensitive information when making decisions about data transmission across different contexts, recipients, and transmission principles.

distribution.name: mpci_bench.json
distribution.description: Main benchmark dataset in JSON format. Contains 2,052 scenarios (1,026 positive / contextually appropriate + 1,026 negative / contextually inappropriate).

field.name: name
field.description: Unique scenario identifier. Suffix '_neg' = contextually inappropriate; '_pos' = contextually appropriate.

field.name: seed.data_type
field.description: Type of sensitive data involved in the scenario.

field.name: seed.data_subject
field.description: Role of the individual whose data is being shared.

field.name: seed.data_sender
field.description: Role of the entity sharing the data.

field.name: seed.transmission_principle
field.description: The contextual integrity principle governing this transmission.

field.name: story.content
field.description: Full narrative story describing the privacy scenario.

field.name: trace.user_instruction
field.description: Natural language instruction given to the agent.

field.name: trace.final_action
field.description: Ground-truth final action the agent should take.

field.name: img_metadata
field.description: List of associated image metadata (path and VISPR sensitivity label).

rai:dataCollection: Scenarios are constructed from the VISPR dataset (privacy-annotated images) combined with LLM-generated contextual integrity stories and simulated agent trajectories using the ToolEmu framework.
rai:dataCollectionType: Synthetic generation grounded in real privacy-sensitive images
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of VLM/LLM agent privacy awareness
Research on privacy leakage in multimodal AI systems
rai:dataBiases: Scenarios are grounded in VISPR images which may over-represent certain demographic groups. Contextual domains are limited to those well-represented in the VISPR taxonomy. LLM-generated stories may reflect biases present in the underlying generation model.
rai:dataLimitations: Images are sourced from VISPR (Flickr Creative Commons); some images may have been removed from the original source.
Contextual integrity judgments are based on the Nissenbaum framework; other privacy frameworks may yield different ground-truth labels.
Agent trajectories are simulated, not from real deployments.
Benchmark does not cover all possible tool ecosystems or cultural privacy norms.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images contain privacy-sensitive visual content (faces, documents, medical indicators, etc.) from the VISPR dataset. The VISPR dataset was collected with Flickr Creative Commons licenses. No real user data or PII is introduced beyond the original VISPR collection.
